- **`router.post('/accounts', async function createAccount(req, res) { ... })`** (lines 7–10): Directly registered async POST handler with named function `createAccount` on `router`.

In `src/routes/orders.ts`:

- **`router.delete('/orders/:id', async (req, res) => { ... })`** (lines 10–13): Directly registered async DELETE handler on `router`.

- **`async value => value.toUpperCase()`** inside `[req.id].map(...)` (line 6): Callback passed to `Array.prototype.map` within the route handler, not a Router registration.
